column1: # Reviewed volatile qualifiers that retail proves (homm3.cleanliness.board).
# A row needs both: semantic evidence (another thread or a modal loop really
# shares the object) and codegen evidence (retail instructions or an order
# VC6 does not emit for the non-volatile object, shown by compiling both).
# A score gain alone never qualifies. A row that admits no site fails the gate.

column4: Semantics: TMapDoc::_autosaveThreadProc (the CWinThread proc started by the constructor) sets it while it holds the autosave mutex and clears it after the close event; ~TMapDoc, OnNewDocument and _autosave read it on the main thread. Codegen: VC6 does not move instructions across a volatile access and does reorder an ordinary one, and retail keeps the volatile order in all four functions. _autosaveThreadProc 0x45efb9 stores 1 before the vtable load and argument setup of the Lock call (non-volatile: the store sinks below them); the constructor 0x45f10f..0x45f140 finishes the member stores up to this one before push [ebp+8] (non-volatile: the push is hoisted into them); OnNewDocument 0x45f34d stores _m_bOfferAutosave = false before reading it (non-volatile: the load is hoisted above the store); _autosave 0x460796 stores _m_lastSaveTime before reading it (non-volatile: hoisted). Without the qualifier: constructor 100 -> 94.12, _autosaveThreadProc 84.59 -> 75.73, OnNewDocument 100 -> 98.69, _autosave 100 -> 97.62.

Semantics: TMapEditorApp::_watchdog runs on the watchdog thread (_watchdogThreadProc) and reads it to post WM_KICKIDLE when the main thread stopped idling; Run and OnIdle write it on the main thread. Codegen: _watchdog 0x45d218 loads it with mov ecx,[esi+0xc8] then sub eax,ecx (VC6 folds an ordinary load into sub eax,[esi+0xc8]); OnIdle 0x45d24e stores it before push [ebp+8] and Run 0x45cfed before mov ecx,esi (non-volatile: both stores sink below the argument setup). Without the qualifier: Run 100 -> 98.95, _watchdog 100 -> 94.29, OnIdle 100 -> 95.00.
